title: Rav Ami bar Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman writes that in Zevachim 108b he asks Rabbi Zeira; but the reading of Shitah Mekubbetzet and Dikdukei Soferim is Rabbi Avin bar Chiyya, and in Avodah Zarah 51b, Rav Assi bar Chiyya.

notes.text: The consulted Zevachim 105b:10–12 has Rabbi Zeira asking Rabbi Ami bar Chiyya, with an alternative Rabbi Avin bar Kahana, about foods joined by liquids. This differs from the supplied 108b locator, the direction of questioning, and Hyman’s reported Avin bar Chiyya variant. The Shitah Mekubbetzet and Dikdukei Soferim readings remain Hyman-attributed, since those exact editions have not been collated here. The separately attested Rav Assi bar Chiyya in Avodah Zarah 51b is not automatically identified with either figure.
